title: Package delivery notification

messages.text: Delivery issue detected. Your package is pending due to address verification failure. Resolve now: https://nexatrust-delvy-check.com/412u
Hi! Your delivery is scheduled tomorrow from 2–4 PM. You can review the schedule anytime on the Mailroom Portal.

explainPoints: Scam link (nexatrust-delvy-check.com): SMS A contains a fake domain link for 'address verification'. SMS B directs to the legitimate Mailroom Portal.
Urgency and problem framing: SMS A creates panic with 'issue detected' and 'failure'. SMS B provides friendly, informational scheduling confirmation.
Suspicious request: SMS A demands immediate action to 'resolve' a fabricated problem. SMS B simply informs about delivery schedule with no action required.
